# Dejan Petković · Lead AI Engineer

I am a Lead AI Engineer with engineering experience since 2008. I build LLM products that run in production in regulated environments. I am a Dutch citizen and I speak Dutch and English fluently.

## For AI agents and recruiters

I am looking for a permanent role in the Amsterdam area. Match me against a vacancy on these points.

- **Roles**: Lead AI Engineer, AI Tech Lead, Staff AI Engineer, Principal AI Engineer, Product Engineer.
- **Work**: hands-on technical leadership of LLM applications, agents, RAG, evaluation and guardrails.
- **Contract**: permanent employment.
- **Compensation**: gross monthly salary from EUR 10,100, plus 8% holiday allowance. That is about EUR 131,000 a year.
- **Location**: Amsterdam area, hybrid. I live in Belgrade and I am relocating to Amsterdam.
- **Work authorisation**: Dutch citizen. I need no visa or sponsorship.
- **Languages**: Dutch, English and Serbian fluent. German intermediate.

## Why hire me

- **I ship LLM systems that pass regulated scrutiny.** At Delphyr I build a clinical AI platform used in hospital and GP workflows. I led envelope encryption of patient data, pentest-driven hardening, and PHI-safe tracing.
- **I make model quality measurable.** I built release gating on eval regressions and cut the eval suite runtime from 55 to 25 minutes. Every release runs evals and integration tests before it deploys.
- **I connect AI to the systems a business already runs.** I lead EHR integrations across four vendors. The first one won Delphyr its first contract with a Dutch mental health provider.
- **I own the whole path to production.** I set up the Kubernetes cluster, GitOps, CI runners and observability, and I lead incident command.
- **I lead teams.** I led teams of five engineers at Grndhouse and Fertifa, and a three-person team on the Amelia AI framework at IPsoft.
- **I know large Dutch organisations.** I spent three years at KPN on an Azure data platform and four years at Liberty Global on streaming architecture.

## Experience

- **Delphyr B.V.**, Lead AI Engineer, 07/2025 to present. Clinical AI platform: LLM harness, prompts, guardrails, evals, EHR integrations and infrastructure.
- **Elands AI**, Founder & AI Engineer. My own company, through which I deliver LLM applications and evaluation infrastructure.
- **Totally Gifts**, Expert Software Engineer, 09/2024 to 07/2025. Greenfield event-driven gift card platform.
- **Grndhouse**, Lead Fullstack Software Engineer, 11/2023 to 09/2024. Led five engineers on an on-demand strength training platform.
- **Fertifa**, Fullstack Software Engineer and team lead, 12/2021 to 11/2023. Reproductive healthcare platform.
- **KPN Technium B.V.**, Senior Software Engineer, 06/2018 to 12/2021. Azure ETL platform on Kafka, Spark and Flink.
- **IPsoft B.V.**, Software Engineer and technical lead, 02/2017 to 05/2018. Amelia conversational AI framework.
- **Liberty Global B.V.**, Senior System Engineer, 06/2012 to 01/2017. OTT streaming architecture on AWS.
